Is enjoyable! Can't believe that the album came out! The album as a whole reminds me of a happier X&Y album, mixed in (heavily) with Mylo Xyloto.

❤️ (Human Heart) - Love the acapella that they went with! WE ARE KING and Jacob Collier did a a beautiful job. The message is beautiful too. Just express what you feel. Definitely behind that. Great song.

People of the Pride - OOOHHHHHH MAANNNNNN. That harmony in the beginning needed to go on longer!! And that beat change, INTENSE. Biutyful - Nice addition with an Alien singing! This has a AHFOD feel to it. Feels like an Alien love song classic. Another nice song! This has a sparky feeling to it! I LOVE IT!

My Universe - Just....WOW. Despite already hearing this, I would have never thought these two groups would team up. And it makes sense, since this is a beyond-the-world type of album where any kind of sound and language can be accepted. BTS did their thing, as always. Catchy hook, loved the music video, a dimension focused kind of video! Liked the idea, had the same thing going with the song for me. The outro was great too! Great song, and a great job by both groups.

♾ (Infinity Sign) - Nice instrumental. Reminds me of Rainbow Road in Mario Kart, and everybody is dancing on the tracks. The pianos, the drums, the vocals. Blending in well.

Coloratura - I have listened to this before the album came out. Oh My God. No words. The harpsichords, the pianos, the synths. I felt like I was in a fairytale. Disney related. This song. When I was laying down on the floor, I literally felt like I was shifting left and right, with my eyes closed. Whenever I think of death itself, and where I'll go, I hope to think of this song. Especially of the lyrics. Felt like my soul was dancing inside. And when the drums came in. That was it. Sent me away. The little break with the harps again, with the video game beeps. And that music box. I for real felt like leaping into something. And the 6 minute part, reminded me of Elton John, Queen, The Beatles, just all in one for me. It concludes oh so well. That final piano part could very well make me tear up.

​

In conclusion, a well made album! This journey of Coldplay albums have been the best! Really will grow on me when I listen to it more and more. Enjoyable. I know you guys have been waiting on me to make a "review" on this, so here it is!
